Proudly made in Tennessee, Penguin Chillers builds high-quality water and glycol chillers trusted for cold therapy, aquatics, and commercial use.

Cold Therapy Chillers | Made in Tennessee | Penguin Chillers
Cold therapy chillers and complete cold plunge systems built in Tennessee, USA. Maintain consistent water temperatures without daily ice purchases.
Cold Therapy Chillers | Made in Tennessee | Penguin Chillers

For a complete system, Summit is our top pick: an integrated chiller, stainless tub, filtration, and insulated cover in one finished setup.

Our top pick for a complete plunge: an integrated chiller, stainless tub, filtration, and insulated cover in one finished setup.

        Which complete cold plunge is best?
Summit is our top recommendation for a complete all-in-one cold plunge, combining an integrated chiller, stainless tub, filtration, and insulated cover. Journey is the portable inflatable choice, and Pursuit is the premium acrylic option with an external chiller.

All-in-One Premium Cold Plunge
 – Penguin Chillers
The Beyond Cold Summit Cold Plunge pairs premium cold therapy with Penguin Chillers' proven cooling technology. Built in Tennessee with U.S. support.
